images.title: Salmon drying at Old Harbor, 1889
images.credit: Photograph by N. B. Miller, 1889. National Archives and Records Administration, NAID 513089, local identifier 22-FA-264.
images.creator: N. B. Miller
images.rightsLabel: Public domain; NARA's Pictures of Native Americans page expressly states that its selected photographs are in the public domain.
images.scope: Historical food-preservation scene at Old Harbor (Nuniaq), an Alutiiq/Sugpiaq community on Kodiak Island. Placement is based on documented community/geography and locally explained naming history. It does not identify the ethnicity, name, status or descent of any person in the photograph, claim continuity of a pictured structure, or depict all Alutiiq communities. Old Harbor is an Alutiiq/Sugpiaq community. The archive preserves the historical label Aleut; Old Harbor Native Corporation explains that Alutiiq, Aleut and Sugpiaq are all names used locally. This image documents a historical place and activity, rather than identifying the individual pictured. Retain the archive's original Aleut wording as historical catalogue terminology. Do not describe the 1889 caption as necessarily an error, and do not reassign this Kodiak community image to the Unangan/Aleut profile solely from that term. The 3000x2449 Commons-hosted NARA reproduction was downloaded unchanged and visually inspected in the first pass. In this follow-up, NARA's own 552x440 reference image was downloaded unchanged and visually inspected; it shows the same scene and frame. The NARA item catalogue returned no readable body, so date/photographer/rights confirmation comes from the actual NARA curated page, item 62 and its introduction. Museum and community bodies were read for scope and naming evidence. No claim is made about the ethnicity of the distant person or details that cannot be read. No private or restricted material was accessed. Any subsequent CSS crop/overlay should be disclosed as presentation treatment. Web copies proportionally resized/recompressed without retouching; CSS crops and overlays are presentation only. Complete image displayed proportionally in the page banner.
images.alt: Salmon drying on outdoor racks beside houses at Old Harbor, photographed in 1889.
